description: Search and retrieve multiple tasks from across the entire workspace using broad filters. Optimized for both specific task lookups (via search_query) and broad hierarchy exploration. Best for answering 'What tasks are related to X?' or 'Find the task with ID Y'. For Date custom fields, you can use natural language values like 'today' or '3 days ago'. To filter by a range (e.g., tasks updated between yesterday and tomorrow), use two filters with inequal operators (>= and <=) on the same field ID.

advanced_filtering.description: Advanced filtering options. Use name_search for targeted name-only matching.

name_search.description: Case-insensitive fuzzy match on task name only (faster and more precise than search_query).

assigneeNames.description: Filter by assignee names or emails. Resolved to user IDs automatically. Use instead of or alongside assignees.

custom_fields.description: Advanced: Filter by specific custom field values as JSON string: [{"field_id": "...", "operator": "=", "value": "..."}]. Supports natural language dates (e.g., "today") and RANGE with two values.

custom_task_types.description: Filter by custom task type names (e.g. ["Milestone", "Requirement"]).

date_created_gt.description: Fetch tasks created after this time (ms or natural language).

date_created_lt.description: Fetch tasks created before this time (ms or natural language).

date_done_gt.description: Fetch tasks resolved/completed after this time (ms or natural language).

date_done_lt.description: Fetch tasks resolved/completed before this time (ms or natural language).

date_updated_gt.description: Fetch tasks updated after this time. Supports Unix timestamp (ms) or natural language (e.g., '3 days ago', 'last week'). Defaults to 7 days ago if no filters are provided. Use '0' to search all-time history.

date_updated_lt.description: Fetch tasks updated before this time (ms or natural language).

detail_level.description: Controls result verbosity. 'names' (ID/name only), 'summary' (flattened for AI context efficiency), or 'detailed' (full metadata). The server may automatically use 'summary' if results are large to stay within token limits.

due_date_gt.description: Fetch tasks due after this time (ms or natural language).

due_date_lt.description: Fetch tasks due before this time (ms or natural language).

folder_ids.description: Filter by exact ClickUp Folder IDs.

include_closed.description: If true, includes tasks in a "closed" status. Default is false.

include_markdown_description.description: Includes rich-text markdown in task descriptions. Recommended if you need to read task content immediately without a second tool call.

include_timl.description: Include tasks added via "Tasks in Multiple Lists" (TIML). Useful for sprint lists where tasks live in a project list but are also assigned to the sprint. Default false.

listNames.description: Filter by one or more List names (e.g., ["Backlog", "Current Sprint"]). Names are resolved to IDs automatically.

list_ids.description: Filter by exact ClickUp List IDs.

order_by.description: The field to sort results by.

reverse.description: If true, sorts in descending order (e.g., newest first).

search_query.description: High-performance search. If this matches a Task ID (e.g., 86afw5805), it returns that exact task immediately. Otherwise, performs a broad fuzzy search across task names, descriptions, and custom fields.

space_ids.description: Filter by exact ClickUp Space IDs.

statuses.description: Filter by status names (e.g., ["to do", "in progress"]).

subtasks.description: Include subtasks in the results. Default is false.

tags.description: Filter by tags (tasks must have ALL specified tags).

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: get_workspace_tasks
